name: Misagi Isuka
source:
The best friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c9335]Amane[/url]. She promised her to take her up on the Morning Glory but it never happened due to an accident. She hides the fact that she has a frail constitution from her friends.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/If_My_Heart_Had_Wings_(visual_novel)]Wikipedia[/url]]
